title: Smoky Chicken Gallina
description: A flavorful Peruvian-inspired dish featuring smoky chicken, zesty aji peppers, and tender de gallina.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
3. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
4. In the same skillet, add the zesty aji pepper paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
5. Add the garlic and smoked paprika to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until the garlic is fragrant.
6. Stir in the de gallina and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
7. Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the de gallina mixture.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
9. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
10. Serve with rice, beans, or roasted vegetables for a complete meal.
